purpose: Out-of-asset replication of btc_multifactor_v1 on Ether options: Double Heston vs Single Heston vs per-expiry Black-Scholes, every model calibrated per date, scored on held-out options. Rules fixed before any ETH option surface is fetched or any model fitted.
venue: Deribit options on futures, ETH-settled (inverse), same convention as BTC
convention: Deribit quotes option prices in ETH as the Black-76 USD price divided by that expiry's futures price, with no discounting. The ETH price is therefore the forward-normalised option price. Calls are used directly; puts are converted with c = p + 1 - K/F. USD value = normalised price x F.
forward: Per trade, solve for F from (trade price, trade iv, K, tau) under the convention. Per expiry, take the median of F/index over that expiry's trades in the window. Each quote's forward is that ratio times the index at its own trade time.
quote: Last trade per instrument in the window. Primary target: trade price. Secondary robustness target: the exchange mark price at that trade.

date_rule.split: No validation stage: every selected date is a test date (Feller variant inherited from BTC validation).
date_rule.unavailable_dates: disclosed; never replaced by other dates

designs.B_heldout_expiries: PRIMARY. Sort a date's expiries by maturity; hold out every odd-ranked expiry except the longest. Calibrate on the remaining expiries (all strikes); score all quotes of held-out expiries. Tests term-structure interpolation, where a second timescale should matter.
designs.A_heldout_strikes: SECONDARY. Within each expiry, sort by strike; hold out odd-ranked strikes. Calibrate on the rest; score held-out strikes.

models.BS_EXPIRY: One Black-76 volatility per calibration expiry (grouped by expiry, per btc AMENDMENT_01); total-variance interpolation between expiry knots, flat outside.
models.SH: Heston, all five parameters calibrated per date and design; feller_free.
models.DH: Double Heston, separable four-shock literature_exact convention, slow-first ordering, all ten parameters calibrated per date and design; feller_free.

variant_selection: Fixed in advance to feller_free for SH and DH, inherited from btc_multifactor_v1/artifacts/variant_selection.json. No ETH date is used for any choice.
objective: Mean squared vega-weighted price residual, (model - market)/vega, with vega the market Black-76 vega in forward units, floored at 1e-4. This is approximately an implied-vol residual. Identical for every model.

optimizer.convergence: Report all starts; count successful starts within max(1e-12, 1% of the best objective). Never claim a proven global optimum.

numerics.fallback: In evaluation, any 96/128 disagreement above tolerance or bound breach uses the independent adaptive quadrature; every fallback is logged.

primary_endpoint: Shock-regime dates, design B. For each episode, average the per-date paired differences in held-out IV RMSE: SH minus DH and BS_EXPIRY minus DH. DH beats a competitor only if the one-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test over episodes gives p < 0.05 AND the episode-cluster bootstrap 95% lower bound of the mean difference is > 0 (5,000 replicates, seed 20260920).
secondary: design A on shock test dates
both designs on calm test dates (control; a smaller DH advantage is expected)
integrity: Dates come from ETH DVOL alone before any ETH option data is fetched; the calm control set is reported alongside.
No filter, split, metric, bound, optimizer setting or endpoint changes after fits are seen.
Failed dates, fits and fallbacks are retained and disclosed.
Trade prices are not synchronized bid/ask; no spread-based claims.
Pre-freeze contact with ETH option data: the current instrument list only (tick size, expiries).
filters_note: min_price_btc is the coin-denominated floor (here ETH), same value as BTC (5 ticks).
